insight: Place mid lane starting observer behind trees on your side to avoid detection by aggressive enemy wards. Fast heroes like Earth Spirit can place it deeper; slower heroes should use safer tree line positions.

matchup_context: against skill shot heroes like Lina, TA
insight: Position observer in middle of lane to see enemy hero positioning for skill shot setup. Against roaming heroes like Tusk/Pudge/Spirit Breaker, move observer to the side to spot rotations.
Place observer to the side where sentries will be concentrated, forcing enemies to waste resources finding both sentries and invisible heroes like Sand King.
Use tower attack trick at night to determine observer location: walk under tower from different angles to see which side it attacks, narrowing sentry search area.
Place second observer defensively near bounty rune area your team contests. Don't defend areas with no bounty runes; position to defend actual fight location instead.
Place deep defensive observer in enemy jungle at night to spot smoke breaks before enemies set up aggressive positions. Allows your team to avoid the ambush.
If mid laner hasn't placed their ward yet, place sneaky observer on bounty rune area to see power rune while enemies expect ward in standard mid location.
Place observer behind trees on right side of radiant mid to see onto high ground. High ground positioning helps secure it longer than low ground placements.
Place observer in river or further toward enemy half. Stay smoked when placing to prevent enemies from knowing ward location in sneaky spots.
Place observer with vision of bounty rune and lane to spot couriers. Position on high ground overlooking bounty area for advantage against hard support rotations.
Block camps in tree line corners to force enemy hard support to search multiple spots. Position mouse carefully and move slowly to place in tight tree line spaces.
When unblocking camps, physically walk through tree lines to verify no blocked camps exist. Don't rely on sentry range alone as vision doesn't cover all corners despite true sight coverage.
Place blocks early at night before lane starts if attempting sneaky block. If coming late, place blocks in far corners of tree lines and immediately return to lane to appear innocent.
Avoid placing observers in common mid-lane positions (guardian ward spots) as they die constantly during early fights. Save these positions for mid-game after lane breaks.
Place laning observer through tree line at night to see rotation through high ground. If daytime, check area is clear first or use river positioning instead.
Place observer on far side of midfield observer to see enemy movement between camps and lane. Avoids common sentry checks concentrated on obvious ward areas.
Use secret pocket observer placements on side of staircase rather than middle to avoid predictable sentry placements. Survival rate increases significantly with off-center positioning.
Place sentries on left or right side of jungle rather than middle to catch all observer positions. Middle sentry placement misses extreme corners.
Place cliff observer to see into ancient camp and watch Tormentor/twin gate activation. Position slightly back from cliff edge to avoid common sentry coverage.
Place observer behind tree line on right side to see people entering triangle. Hard to spot and survives longer than middle placements even with sentries nearby.
Place observer on far right of staircase in corner to avoid common sentry checks. Enemies often place sentries center or left, leaving right corners uncovered.
Place observer with vision into triangle to see Roshan rotations. Avoid obvious cliff positions in favor of lower ledge placements to survive longer.
Place observer on ledge rather than middle of lane to avoid standard sentry checks. Ledge observers see enough lane information while surviving longer.
If able to cut tree with Quelling Blade, place observer on bottom corner ledge without blocking camp. Provides solid vision while appearing less suspicious than standard positions.
Place observers at edge of staircase or deep in corners rather than middle. Center placements get checked too frequently and don't provide better vision.
Walk on high ground and position observer at edge of cliff to see into triangle. Sentries placed in center often miss these edge positions.
Push observer as far to edge as possible rather than center placement. Center drops get checked by sentries; edges survive longer due to predictable sentry coverage.
Use deep low ground observer placements to avoid multiple high ground sentry checks. Requires more map knowledge but significantly improves survival rates.
Cut specific trees to enable observer placements with better vision. Cutting reveals your plan but unlocks spots enemies can't easily clear.
Place observer on high ground to see shrine and rotations through area. Multiple trees allow flexibility in exact positioning to avoid standard sentries.
Place observer to see enemies pushing from side areas rather than middle. Harder for enemies to predict since many focus sentries on obvious cliff positions.
Place observers outside of front sentry line while sieging. Push one sentry range beyond enemy front line to see actual push positioning and heroes waiting behind trees.
Place observer on low ground to see enemies descending Roshan stairs. High ground placement can't see when enemies commit to pit; low ground reveals the timing.
Position sentries in river area to catch observers while covering multiple approaches. Don't place directly in front of pit stairs as enemies can use adjacent positions.
Place observer in top corner of pit above the pit entrance. Even with sentry down, enemies often can't see it without walking directly into corner.
Don't place observers too close together or in obvious patterns. Mix up ward locations to force enemies to use multiple sentries instead of one covering both.
Take wide paths away from creeps and towers when placing wards. Don't cut through lane creeps or attack range as it reveals observer location to enemies.
Use nighttime to place observers in aggressive positions that would get spotted in day. Tower vision is reduced at night, allowing deeper ward placement.
Smoke when placing sneaky deep wards to avoid being spotted. Enemies won't know where you placed ward if smoke breaks while out of vision.
Place sentries on edges of common observer areas rather than center. Many players don't walk to extreme corners to check, leaving multiple wards alive.
